sources.summary: Residents of Gilroy, California, were caught by surprise when an Amazon data center started construction in their city. Negotiations for the project started in 2020, with public comments open until 2024, but it flew under the radar.

stories.title: AI creates 16 new viruses that never existed in nature after learning DNA’s pattern from 9 trillion nucleotides — experts warn such applications are way ahead of necessary guardrails

sources.title_original: AI creates 16 new viruses that never existed in nature after learning DNA’s pattern from 9 trillion nucleotides — experts warn such applications are way ahead of necessary guardrails
sources.summary: Researchers used Evo AI models trained on trillions of DNA building blocks to design entirely new viral genomes, 16 of which became viable bacteriophages capable of infecting and reproducing inside E. coli.

stories.title: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute

sources.title: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute
sources.title_en: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute
sources.title_original: Hardware researcher spins up 'CPU deoptimization' project to find the slowest single x86 instruction, creates hall of shame — worst offender takes 198 billion cycles spanning 62 seconds to execute
sources.summary: One hardware researcher, Christopher Domas (@xoreaxeaxeax on GitHub), is taking a different approach with the CPU Deoptimization leaderboard, which looks not to make Assembly instructions run as fast as possible, but as slow as possible to find the single instruction with the highest latency.
sources.summary_zh: 一位硬件研究员 Christopher Domas（GitHub 上的@xoreaxeaxeax）正在对 CPU 去优化排行榜采取不同的方法，它看起来不是让汇编指令运行得尽可能快，而是尽可能慢地找到延迟最高的单个指令。

stories.title: Modder turns Steam Controller trackpad haptics into stereo speakers with custom HID tool — Wired connection transmits 16-bit audio that sounds surprisingly full

sources.title_original: Modder turns Steam Controller trackpad haptics into stereo speakers with custom HID tool — Wired connection transmits 16-bit audio that sounds surprisingly full
sources.summary: A modder has figured out how to send an audio stream to the Steam Controller's haptic motors in order to make them play pretty much anything. While the wireless connection over the puck is limited, audio quality over a USB cable is genuinely impressive for a device with no speakers.
sources.summary_zh: 一名改装者已经弄清楚如何将音频流发送到 Steam 控制器的触觉电机，以便让它们播放几乎任何东西。虽然冰球上的无线连接有限，但对于没有扬声器的设备来说，通过 USB 电缆传输的音频质量确实令人印象深刻。

items.title_original: Modder turns Steam Controller trackpad haptics into stereo speakers with custom HID tool — Wired connection transmits 16-bit audio that sounds surprisingly full
items.summary: A modder has figured out how to send an audio stream to the Steam Controller's haptic motors in order to make them play pretty much anything. While the wireless connection over the puck is limited, audio quality over a USB cable is genuinely impressive for a device with no speakers.
items.summary_zh: 一名改装者已经弄清楚如何将音频流发送到 Steam 控制器的触觉电机，以便让它们播放几乎任何东西。虽然冰球上的无线连接有限，但对于没有扬声器的设备来说，通过 USB 电缆传输的音频质量确实令人印象深刻。
